shared_elements: relief carving in low relief on a flat face
horizontal registers or bands dividing the surface
repeated small motifs arranged in a row
curved/rounded abstract shapes within rectangular compartments
justification: Both are upright stone slabs bearing low-relief carving organised into stacked horizontal registers of repeated compartmentalised motifs, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ sharply: A shows sparse, large, isolated zoomorphic figures (a bird-like head, quadruped, snake-like form) against ample blank ground, while B is a dense, uniform grid of small, tightly packed rounded glyph-like blocks covering the entire surface with no figural imagery or empty field.
